title: Mechanosensitive genomic enhancers potentiate the cellular response to matrix stiffness
model: CRISPRi tiling of DNase-hypersensitive sites around MYH9, FACS for MYH9 protein
contrast: MYH9-low vs MYH9-high sort, paired by replicate (2 vs 2)
paper_calls: Promoter (DHS 71, 72) and intron-3 mechanoenhancers (DHS 45-47) regulate MYH9
barcs_calls: 99 elements at FDR 0.10 after control calibration
verdict: BARCS ranks the paper's intron-3 mechanoenhancers (DHS 45, 47, 46) as the top three elements and the promoter element DHS 72 fifth. Non-targeting guides were strongly inflated (56% at p < 0.05), so calls were calibrated; the top elements are unaffected.
